title: the-constrain-floor-reads-this-builds-instruments-in-bounded-time
intention: A chart's constrain floor discovers only the proofs of the ticket's own component (RULE 1): for a build in cairn/devices/tester it asks about the tester's proofs and no other component's, so its time is bounded by that one component's proofs.
why: RULE 1 (Akien, agreed 2026-10-01): a ticket's proofs measure only its own component — 'we'd only have to run the tests for the changed files and not for all files'. On 2026-10-05 b312ff041558's constrain stage (a one-file tester build) discovered 70 proofs across 6 components — 14 bus, 9 harbor_master, 7 ground_loop, 3 cairn, 1 sleep_cycle, 2 scratch beside the tester's — 62 without a standing seal, and ran them one by one over the bus at up to 180s each; the stage hung over 10 minutes. The out-of-component proofs are a RULE 1 break, not only a timing cost. The lived symptom is a builder waiting on a chart that measures components the build never touched.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver is not spent re-deriving the settled — a chart that re-runs 62 proofs to report what seals already say is that defect); Akien's ruling that nothing runs inside the bus (re-plan 2026-10-05); RULE 1 (the change stays in the constrain machine; the tester is asked only through its public interface)
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/constrain.py discovered_instruments: scope discovery to the ticket's component (the component whose charter is the ticket's owning_intention, which also holds its writes_to), instead of every component the orient refs resolve to. Context refs stay as constraints of kind charter, but contribute no instruments. These proofs today run OVER THE BUS (constrain asks the tester's run verb through bus_client.reach('tester')); Akien ruled nothing runs inside the bus, and re-plan step 5 takes proofs off the bus, removing the bus waits. Re-measure the floor's wall time after the reshape (and after step 5); only if the stall is still there, add parallel runs under one budget — not the lead design.
falsifier: GREEN when a proof under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/proofs/ shows: for an orient berth whose ticket's component is cairn/devices/tester and whose refs also resolve to other components, discovered_instruments returns tester proofs only, every one under cairn/devices/tester/proofs/, and none from the other ref'd components; and a re-measure of the b312-shaped chart records the constrain stage's wall time. WRONG INTENT if Akien rules a chart must judge context components too.

decisions.text: D1: WHERE. One change in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/constrain.py: discovered_instruments(intent_ref, root=CAIRN_ROOT, *, tickets_dir=None) gains a keyword-only tickets_dir (None = the commons default that cairn.tools.base.ticket_file.plans_of reads), plus one helper _ticket_component(ticket_id, root, tickets_dir) -> str | None beside it. No caller changes: instrument_constraints and inspect_constrain call it as today.

D2: THE TICKET'S COMPONENT. _ticket_component: if ticket_id is not a 12-lowercase-hex string -> None. plans = ticket_file.plans_of(ticket_id, tickets_dir); not exactly one -> None. doc = ticket_file.read_ticket(plans[0]) (any exception -> None). oi = str(doc.get('owning_intention','')).strip(); it must end in '/intention+why.json' and os.path.join(root, oi) must be a file, else None. Return the absolute directory os.path.dirname(os.path.join(root, oi)).

D3: THE SCOPE. In discovered_instruments, after reading the orient berth: comp = _ticket_component(orient_packet.get('ticket'), root, tickets_dir). If comp is not None: comp_dirs = [comp] and the refs contribute NO instruments (they remain charter constraints through constrain_floor, untouched). Then every discovered path is kept only when address.component_of(str(path), os.path.join(root, 'cairn')) resolves to comp (compare as os.path.realpath strings), so a nested machine's proofs under a device do not count as the device's (RULE 1: each is its own component). If comp is None (an unclaimed chart, or a claim whose owning_intention does not resolve), behaviour is exactly today's: every ref'd component, no nested filter.

D4: THE PROOF. cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/proofs/test_the_floor_discovers_only_the_tickets_component.py, check()/FAILURES/TEETH/main shape, _REPO = parents[6], every constrain import inside its tooth, a fixture world under cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir('testing-b0e608f34ccb-'): a tickets dir holding aaaaaaaaaaaa-fixture.json {id, title, owning_intention: 'cairn/devices/tester/intention+why.json', falsifier} plus its .state.json {workflow_and_state}, and an orient berth JSON {request, intent, ticket: 'aaaaaaaaaaaa', refs: ['cairn/devices/tester/cli.py', 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py', 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master']}. root = the live repo. PROVES = {'b0e608f34ccb': {'all': 'test_the_floor_holds_every_clause_of_the_falsifier'}}. Teeth: (1) test_a_claimed_floor_discovers_only_the_tickets_component: discovered_instruments(berth, tickets_dir=fixture) is non-empty and every path starts with 'cairn/devices/tester/proofs/'; (2) test_no_other_refd_component_contributes: no path starts with 'cairn/devices/cairn/'; (3) test_an_unclaimed_floor_reads_every_ref: the same berth without 'ticket' returns paths under both cairn/devices/tester/ and cairn/devices/cairn/ (today's behaviour kept). Run under bin/cairn test --exec twice; hollow reverts constrain.py.

D5: THE RE-MEASURE (the falsifier's wall time). The verdict times constrain_floor over the b312-shaped orient berth /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/orient-20261005T155459-790599c1b3f8.json after the build and records seconds and instrument count; the 2026-10-05 baseline is the ticket's own 70 proofs across 6 components, over 10 minutes. Parallel runs are NOT built here (children: none); only if the re-measure still stalls is a follow-up cast.
